capabilities: Send full notes or selected text to configured webhook endpoints
Include YAML frontmatter, inline fields, and base64 attachments in the payload
Insert webhook responses back into notes with append, new-note, or overwrite modes
Send rendered HTML of the active note in Reading View
Attach reusable context notes and parameters to webhook requests
extras: The README links to external n8n workflow templates for its use cases (email, Airtable queries, podcast feed) rather than including them inline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push note content to external automation services, so connecting notes to workflows requires manual copying.

relations.evidence: Each webhook has a unique command ID that can be used with Templater templates
useful for notes that contain data from the Dataview or Bases plugin

requires.name: A webhook endpoint such as n8n, Make.com, or Zapier

summary: Webhook sender that posts notes, selections, frontmatter, inline fields, and attachments to endpoints like n8n, Make.com, and Zapier.
